newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UN human rights body hits at Burma.
newsitem.headline: UN human rights body hits at Burma.

text.p: The world's supreme body for human rights voiced concern about continuing rights violations by the military rulers of Burma in a resolution passed on Wednesday.

The resolution adopted by consensus at the 53-member U.N. Human Rights Commission listed a long list of abuses including extrajudicial, summary and arbitrary executions, deaths in custody, torture, arbitrary arrests and forced child labour.
The resolution extended the mandate of the special U.N. human rights investigator for Burma and urged Rangoon to cooperate with the envoy.

The U.S. and many other Western countries have criticised Burma for human rights abuses and for failing to recognise the democratically elected government of the National League for Democracy, which was co-founded by Suu Kyi.
